text: So many people are complaining about the price and calling this place a tourist scam. However, we are in the middle of Southeast Asia, and having an emergency facility like this (with English-speaking doctors and nurses) is pure luck! I was stung by a stingray and they took very good care of me. They gave me medication, which is probably why I paid almost 8,000 THB. To be honest, I’m just so happy to have found an emergency clinic so close to where the accident happened that I can’t complain.

restaurant_name: First Standard clinic Klong Muang คลินิกเวชกรรม เฟริส สเเตนดาร์ด สาขา คลองม่วง
text: PLEASE do NOT go here for pediatric care! The staff were lovely and friendly and the clinic is nice and clean - great if you are an adult who needs care. We took our infant son here for his eyes to be checked as we suspected him to have conjunctivitis at the back end of having a nasty cold (which we all had contracted) his eye was looked at and told to just keep washing it with saline wash (which we were sold at the clinic for much higher price then next door at 7/11) we were then given a huge bag of medicine & antibiotics, de-congestants, cough medicine, sickness meds, electrolytes we were told to give with water? Our baby is 6 months old and breastfed so this was the first red flag as babies this age shouldn't even be given mineral water due to the salt content let alone electrolytes. I did question if these things are ok for babies as they were adult meds and was reassured that babies can have them in smaller quantities? Being ill and not really with it ourselves we bought the bag of meds and went back to the hotel, I didn't feel comfortable giving my baby a huge cocktail of drugs so did a bit of research to find that it is dangerous to give any of the meds the doctor had told us to give him as they can cause serious side effects or even death as suggested by the FDA due to his very young age (my husband did get to use some of them as he was also ill so it wasn't a total waste.) I wish we had walked out as soon as he started suggesting this cocktail of drugs  as my gut told me it was wrong but when a medical professional is telling you it's ok you should be able to trust them. I think they just wanted to sell us as many different products as possible, nothing actually for the conjunctivitis. We went to a pharmacy in Krabi town who did give us some eye drops which helped baby immediately and only cost 90THB. Please be vigilant if you are taking your baby to a clinic.
